title: unified-rollouts: proactive autorollback workflow enhancements
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Enhances proactive autorollback workflow: metric quorum, staged probing windows, observability hooks, and additional e2e stability tests. Backwards-compatible config defaults preserved.
description:
Motivation: Customers have requested stronger safety guarantees for proactive autorollback in mixed deployment modes (canary, A/B, shadow). This change improves the workflow by adding a quorum-based metric aggregation, configurable probing windows for shadow traffic, explicit quarantine handling, and richer telemetry to reduce false positives and improve time-to-detection.

What I changed (high level): - Implemented quorum-based metric evaluation so rollbacks require agreement across multiple critical metrics instead of single-metric thresholds. - Added staged probing windows for shadow and canary phases to avoid noisy early signals. - Introduced a manual 'quarantine' override that pauses rollouts and surfaces actionable diagnostics. - Hooked detailed rollout span attributes into tracing and added per-rollout Prometheus metrics for decision path visibility. - Added golden-path e2e tests and expanded the unit test matrix to include noisy-metric simulations. - Documentation and config examples for operators.

Why: Previous autorollback behavior occasionally reverted healthy rollouts due to transient metric spikes. The quorum and staged probing reduce flapping while keeping automatic protection. Observability improvements shorten debugging time when rollbacks do trigger.

Rollout plan: Feature gated under rollout.autorollback.v2 (disabled by default). We will enable for canary-only experiments in staging for 2 weeks, then enable for internal dedicated clusters before a full rollout.

Compatibility: Backwards compatible with existing rollout strategies. If operators enable the v2 gate they get the new behavior; default remains the current autorollback behavior to avoid surprises.

Related: ENG-1892 (autorollback heuristic improvements), ENG-2003 (rollout telemetry), SUP-4821 (customer-reported false-positive rollbacks).
commits: feat(autorollback): add quorum-based metric evaluator and config
feat(rollout): staged probing windows for shadow/canary phases
chore(tests): add e2e stability tests and noisy-metric fixtures
docs(rollouts): add v2 autorollback rollout guide and examples
perf(telemetry): add per-rollout Prometheus metrics and trace attributes
fix(quarantine): ensure manual quarantine persists across controller restarts
diff_snippets: +++ pkg/rollout/autorollback/quorum_evaluator.go: Added QuorumEvaluator that aggregates metric verdicts and requires N-of-M agreement before triggering rollback.
+++ pkg/rollout/autorollback/probing_window.go: New staged probing window types (initial_probe, stabilization_probe) with configurable durations.
~ pkg/rollout/controller/rollback_controller.go: Integrated QuorumEvaluator and added feature-gate check rollout.autorollback.v2.
+++ e2e/rollouts/autorollback_stability_test.go: added test that simulates transient spike and asserts no rollback when quorum not met.
review_comments: Diego Rivera (reviewer): The quorum approach looks good, can you clarify default quorum values and how they map to existing SLOs?
Asha Menon (author): Default configured to 2-of-3 for critical metrics; added mapping table in docs/rollouts/autorollback_v2.md explaining mappings to common SLOs.
Lena Park (reviewer): We should ensure trace spans include the decision tree so the oncall can quickly see why rollback happened. Consider adding rollout_id and decision_reasons attributes.
Asha Menon (author): Added trace attributes rollout.id and autorollback.decision_reasons; included a comment about cardinality in rollout_metrics.go and kept attributes low-cardinality.
Markus Vogel (reviewer): e2e tests are flaky on the first run in CI (timing). Can we make the noisy-metric fixtures deterministic?
Asha Menon (author): Adjusted the test harness to seed deterministic noise and increased stabilization window for CI runs. Re-ran CI and tests passed.
notes: Feature gated as rollout.autorollback.v2=false by default to avoid surprise changes.
Ops: to enable in staging set rollout.autorollback.v2=true in config and monitor rollout.autorollback.decisions histogram.
Follow-ups: ENG-2057 to add UI surface in Console to view quorum decision breakdown per rollout.
Backported: no backport required; planned as a minor release in 2026.02.
